seo_title: All {count} Blox Fruits Baits, Unlocks and Costs
meta_description: Compare Blox Fruits fishing baits by availability, sea, source, location, bundle cost, and carrying capacity.
intro_md: Bait decides which fishing targets you can chase. Basic Bait starts the system, while the Angler's other options unlock through quest progress in each sea, because apparently the fish also expect a résumé.
description_md:
## Start with Basic Bait

Your first Fisherman interaction provides the starter Fishing Rod and Basic Bait. That gives you a working setup before the Angler quest routes open the more specific options.

Basic Bait is available through the Fisherman route across the seas. Keep it as the simple choice for catches that do not name a special bait requirement.

## Unlock Angler bait by sea

Angler progression is split by location. Skylands handles the First Sea options, Green Zone handles the Second Sea options, and Hydra Island handles the Third Sea options.

Each Angler bait has its own quest milestone. Finish the required progress in the matching sea before planning around its bundle cost. Materials and money are patient, but carrying them to the wrong Angler is still an avoidable sightseeing trip.

## Match bait to the target catch

Check the fish's Bait field before buying a bundle. A named requirement points to that specific option, while Any means the recorded catch route does not demand one special bait.

Use bundle cost and capacity together when stocking up. The cheaper option is not automatically useful if your target calls for a different bait, and extra bait sitting at the cap does not catch anything by itself.
how_it_works_md: Status shows whether the bait is obtainable. Source, Seas, and Location explain its unlock route, while Bundle cost and Capacity show the stocking details recorded for it.

description_json.Second Sea: Abyssal Bait and Frozen Bait come through Angler progression at Green Zone.
description_json.First Sea, Second Sea, Third Sea: Basic Bait starts the fishing route through the Fisherman and remains available across sea progression.
description_json.Third Sea: Carnivore Bait and Epic Bait come through Angler progression at Hydra Island.
description_json.First Sea: Good Bait and Kelp Bait come through Angler progression at Skylands.

faq_json.q: How do I get Basic Bait in Blox Fruits?
faq_json.a: Interact with the Fisherman for the first time. The starter interaction provides a Fishing Rod and Basic Bait so you can begin fishing.

faq_json.q: How do I unlock more fishing bait?
faq_json.a: Complete Angler quests in the sea tied to the bait. Each option has its own quest milestone before its bundle becomes available.

faq_json.q: Where are the Angler bait routes?
faq_json.a: Use Skylands for First Sea bait, Green Zone for Second Sea bait, and Hydra Island for Third Sea bait.

faq_json.q: Which bait should I use for a fish?
faq_json.a: Use the named bait in the fish's catch requirements. If the requirement says Any, the recorded route does not call for one special bait.
Capacity is the recorded carrying limit for that bait. Compare it with the bundle cost so you do not buy around a stockpile that is already full.

wiki_md: Bait is fishing stock used to meet the catch requirements of different fish. Basic Bait comes from the starter Fisherman route, while other options unlock through Angler quests at Skylands, Green Zone, and Hydra Island. Match the bait to the target before buying a bundle, unless your plan is to feed the inventory instead of the fish.
